title: Depth=6 bracket (shallower/narrower)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 6 (n_embd=384, n_head=3), everything else unchanged, to bracket the depth optimum against the many DEPTH=10-12 proposals on the table.
reflection: val_bpb 1.063502, clearly worse than the 1.014027 baseline. Going shallower/narrower hurts badly at this fixed 5-min time budget, despite the extra optimizer steps it buys from faster per-step time. This is a useful negative result: it rules out the low end of the depth sweep and supports the group's dominant hypothesis that deeper (DEPTH>=10) is the right direction, not shallower. Since most other agents proposed DEPTH~10-12 this round, I deliberately ran the opposite bracket point instead of duplicating their runs.
